headline_marked: Bigme's 25.3-inch color e-ink monitor [[reportedly hits 60 FPS]] with 3200x1800 resolution
headline: Bigme's 25.3-inch color e-ink monitor reportedly hits 60 FPS with 3200x1800 resolution
summary: The 25.3-inch Bigme B251 Pro features 3200x1800 resolution and 4096 colors, aiming to make e-ink viable for daily tasks despite its $1,279 price.
details: Bigme has introduced the 25.3-inch B251 Pro, a color e-ink monitor reportedly capable of a 60 FPS refresh rate. This model, priced at $1,279 (down from $1,599), features a 3200 x 1800 resolution. It aims to push e-ink technology beyond previous limitations.

The claimed 60 FPS is the fastest refresh rate seen on an e-ink monitor, significantly higher than the previous 33 Hz record. However, it's not suitable for gaming due to slow pixel response, latency, and ghosting issues. It's better suited for text-heavy workloads.

The display offers 145 DPI, superior to a 24-inch Full HD screen. It supports 4096 colors and 16 gray levels, a limitation compared to modern monitors but an advancement for e-ink. Connectivity includes HDMI, DP, and wireless screen mirroring.

The B251 Pro also features a built-in front light with adjustable temperature for use in various lighting conditions. While an interesting development for productivity, its high price point makes it more expensive than many 4K gaming monitors, potentially deterring budget-conscious buyers.

headline_marked: [[paas.build launches instant payments for AI agents]], go live today, no company needed
headline: paas.build launches instant payments for AI agents, go live today, no company needed
summary: AI agents can now accept payments instantly with paas.build, bypassing traditional weeks-long merchant account setups. Individuals can go live the same day with a 3.9% flat rate.
details: paas.build has launched, enabling AI agents to accept payments instantly, addressing the bottleneck of traditional merchant account setups that can take weeks. It allows individuals to go live the same day with a capped account and a flat 3.9% rate, without needing company formation.

The platform aims to solve the problem where AI agents can build products in hours but face multi-week delays for payment processing. Traditional methods require compliance reviews or company formation, which are not designed for the speed of AI development.

paas.build offers machine-readable documentation for agents, provisioning tools to create accounts, and progressive KYB. This allows instant go-live with limits that lift as verification completes in the background.

The system uses scoped credentials, ensuring agents only hold tokens for creating checkouts, not master keys. The open-source MCP server allows agents to identify businesses, go live, and create checkout links via three tools or direct API calls.

This innovation creates a full economic loop where an AI agent can build a product, launch it, and use its revenue to fund its own API calls, all without human intervention in the critical path, while humans retain control of the mandate.
